description: Live intercity bus departures in Thailand for one route and date, with departure time, bus company, boarding point and lowest fare in Thai baht. Each departure includes a booking_url that opens that bus on bestbus.me, where the traveller chooses seats and pays, and a map link for its boarding point.

language.description: Booking page language: en, th, zh, ru, fr, es, it, ms, uk, ar

to_town.description: Destination town in English, e.g. Phuket

title: Search buses on a date
